posts.headline: The draft is officially old news, Thicks — now #FreeMaxx Champions has to defend that ring with an actual season instead of an offseason of hype.
posts.detail: Ten editions of buildup are over and the roster is set; a 14-14 career mark and one title mean the receipts are due starting Week 1, not another excuse-filled offseason.

posts.headline: One Nut Barner keeps ducking the beef, but a 20-8 record and back-to-back top-2 finishes with STILL zero rings is the most Cowboys thing happening in this entire league.
posts.detail: Put it in Ra has the best win percentage in Busters Anonymous history at .714 and a career-best average finish of 1.5, yet the trophy case stays empty — pedigree without a payoff is just a nicer way of choking.

posts.headline: talentedtenthh drafted from the deepest hole in the league and now the untalented tenth has nowhere left to hide behind offseason optimism.
posts.detail: A 4-10 record and dead-last 12th-place finish is the floor, and with the draft in the books, Chauncey either proves the name wrong or lives down to it all season.

posts.headline: Big Head's championship banner has survived six editions of fluke accusations, and now Sasinci's World actually has to go defend it on the field.
posts.detail: A losing 13-15 career record under a title is the strangest résumé in the league — either Megamind proves the ring was real or the milk man serenades his way to another quiet exit threat by October.

posts.headline: SwooshAnoosh survived nine straight editions of burial with a full roster in hand, and now an 11th-place, 5-9 debut is the only story left to rewrite.
posts.detail: Zero titles, a .357 win percentage, and the worst finish in the building last time out — the excuses are gone and the season is about to start keeping score for real.
